Notes: the family's only feature. Two config points, both oracle-asserted: gabor.cpp_static_defaults (test_2d_gabor_cpp_static_defaults_skimage) and gabor.python_raw_defaults (test_2d_gabor_python_raw_defaults_skimage), both on bench_dsb2018_2d. No regression file exists and none is needed - every pinned value carries an oracle claim. The oracle list is skimage;analytic rather than skimage alone: skimage supplies the KERNEL, while the f0=0 member and the WND-CHARM count-ratio SCORE are analytic (skimage has no native equivalent of the score, and gabor_kernel cannot express frequency 0). A full-feature oracle would be wndcharm, which is not built in this tree. The GPU path carries no oracle claim and is guarded size-only by test_2d_gabor_gpu_runs_mechanics.
